title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
Part 2 is in. `serializeNode` writes Document, Doctype, Element, Text, and Comment nodes, using the mirror for ids. Boolean attributes with no value are `true`. A script element stays, with no children. Names that start with `on` are left out.

Checks that passed: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`.

Still open: parts 3–5 (URLs, styles, SVG, shadow DOM, privacy, `takeFullSnapshot`). The issue definition of done is not met yet.
